What a bite does

Muscle breakdown (myotoxicity) and paralysis typically progress over several hours.

Name and taxonomy. Formerly Enhydrina schistosa; moved to Hydrophis.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
